title: 紐約 Freshkills 公園掩埋場復育
summary: Freshkills的公園功能建立在掩埋場工程覆蓋與持續監測之上。學徒要把雨水、滲出水、氣體、沉陷和植被畫成分開但互相影響的路徑。
summaryEn: Freshkills park functions above engineered landfill containment and monitoring. Learners separate, then reconnect, stormwater, leachate, gas, settlement and vegetation pathways.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 覆蓋層水量邊界：覆蓋層水量平衡：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Cover-system water balance: Cover-system water balance: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 覆蓋層水量邊界：覆蓋層水量平衡 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Cover-system water balance: Cover-system water balance and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 降雨被分成逕流、蒸散、儲水變化與向下滲漏；綠色覆蓋並不表示滲漏已受控制。本單元在「覆蓋層水量邊界」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Rain partitions into runoff, evapotranspiration, storage change and percolation; green cover does not prove leakage control. Examine this relationship at cover-system water balance.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：P=100、R=30、ET=40、ΔS=10 mm，同一期間。公式 Perc=P-R-ET-ΔS；代入 100-30-40-10 = 20 mm。適用邊界：面積平均帳，未表示襯層缺陷造成的局部滲漏。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: P=100, R=30, ET=40 andΔS=10 mm over the same period. Formula Perc=P-R-ET-ΔS; substitution 100-30-40-10 = 20 mm. Boundary: Area-average ledger; localized leakage through liner defects is not represented.
steps.failure: 沉陷破壞排水坡度會造成積水與局部滲漏。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Settlement can reverse drainage slopes, causing ponding and local leakage. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 比較氣象、水位與滲出水流量，檢查季節儲水變化。在離線場景為「覆蓋層水量邊界」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Compare weather, water levels and leachate flow and inspect seasonal storage. Build an offline evidence table for cover-system water balance; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

workedExample.text: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：P=100、R=30、ET=40、ΔS=10 mm，同一期間。公式 Perc=P-R-ET-ΔS；代入 100-30-40-10 = 20 mm。適用邊界：面積平均帳，未表示襯層缺陷造成的局部滲漏。
workedExample.textEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: P=100, R=30, ET=40 andΔS=10 mm over the same period. Formula Perc=P-R-ET-ΔS; substitution 100-30-40-10 = 20 mm. Boundary: Area-average ledger; localized leakage through liner defects is not represented.
